item.title: India's top court angry after junior judge cites fake AI-generated orders
item.description:
📝 India's top court angry after junior judge cites fake AI-generated orders1 hour agoShareSaveAnahita SachdevShareSaveGetty ImagesSenior judges at the Supreme Court in Delhi have threatened consequences over the use of AI India's Supreme Court has threatened legal consequences after a judge was found to have adjudicated on a property dispute using fake judgements generated by artificial intelligence. The high court had also sought a report from the junior judge who had used the AI-generated rulings. The high court also advocated for the "exercise of actual intelligence over artificial intelligence".
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c178zzw780xo

item.description:
